user.title: MyKi
user.description: Connect to your MyKi (Allterco) account. The credentials are the same you use in the MyKi Spot app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MyKi
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password is no longer valid for {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the MyKi cloud. Try again.
error.no_watches: This account has no MyKi trackers. Add one in the MyKi app first.

abort.already_configured: This MyKi account is already configured.

contact.title: Edit {setting}
contact.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Clear the field to remove this contact. Save writes only this slot and verifies cloud readback. SOS contact edits affect the physical SOS button.

device.title: Device and battery
device.description: Operating mode can affect device behavior. The SIM number is account metadata, not SIM programming.

setting.title: Edit {setting}
setting.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Save writes only the selected setting and verifies cloud readback. No preference is stored in HA. Default status LED behavior is not a promise of continuous illumination.

zone.title: Edit {setting}
zone.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Select the center on the map and adjust the radius in meters. Nothing is sent until you save. This edits the same zone as the MyKi app, not an HA zone. Color remains phone-local.

alarm.title: Edit {setting}
alarm.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Use the tracker's local time with zero seconds. An enabled alarm needs at least one weekday. Other alarms are preserved. Physical timezone/DST behavior is not verified.

dnd.title: Edit {setting}
dnd.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Use tracker local time with zero seconds. Enabled start/end must differ. Only the first period is edited; other cloud periods are preserved. Disabling clears the first period.

error.invalid_input: Invalid value. Check the fields; times must have zero seconds and enabled schedules need valid times/days.

abort.settings_saved: The setting was verified in the MyKi cloud. No tracker preference was saved in HA.
abort.integration_not_loaded: Load or reauthenticate the integration before editing tracker settings.
abort.tracker_removed: The tracker is no longer available on this account. Reopen configuration to refresh the list.
abort.invalid_settings: Cloud settings are missing or malformed. Inspect the MyKi app and refresh; no values were invented or written.
abort.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Reauthenticate the integration before continuing.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to read MyKi settings. No setting was written.
abort.write_failed: The edit was rejected or its result could not be verified. The tracker may have changed. Reopen configuration and inspect the current values before retrying; no automatic retry or rollback was performed.

power_off.name: Power off tracker
power_off.description: Stop tracking and calls. Physical access is needed to power on; no remote power-on is known. Success means cloud acceptance only.

confirm.name: I understand physical access is required to power the tracker back on

restart.name: Restart tracker
restart.description: Request a reboot, temporarily interrupting tracking and calls. Not a factory reset. Cloud acceptance does not prove reboot or configuration retention.

confirm.name: I accept the interruption and can physically recover the tracker if needed

set_safe_zone.name: Set safe zone
set_safe_zone.description: Edit one MyKi zone, preserving omitted fields. Radius in meters.

set_dnd.name: Set Do not disturb
set_dnd.description: Edit the first period, preserving the other three. Tracker HH:MM wall-clock times, without timezone conversion.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Edit one shared alarm, preserving other slots. Tracker HH:MM wall-clock times, without timezone conversion.

find.name: Find tracker
find.description: Make the tracker ring so you can locate it.

make_call.name: Make tracker call
make_call.description: Call an SOS or whitelist slot shared with the MyKi app.
